claim: Within about 80 years, Christians were worshipping Christ as divine.

bible.note: An early hymn-like passage honoring Christ.
Opens by describing Christ in divine terms.

outside.source: Pliny the Younger, Letter 10.96 to Trajan
outside.note: A Roman governor reports that Christians meet before dawn and sing a hymn to Christ as to a god.

counter: This shows what early Christians believed, not that the belief was true.
